name: sam-03
reading_goal: Explore potential use in my research
research_context: 我是 computer vision 方向的 PhD，研究如何从网络上公开的照片生成可以用于 AR 的 3D assets。
moves: Ask how the paper evaluates its results and which metrics it uses.
Refer to 'that comparison' with a short reference and ask which baselines it compares against and whether it wins on all of them.
Ask whether the paper tested on in-the-wild photos from the internet.
Ask what limitations the authors themselves mention.
Ask PaperLens to separate clearly: which of the points so far are the authors' claims and which are PaperLens's own interpretation.
